title: A generative framework for unified representations bridging electrophysiological and haemodynamic brain activity
abstract: arXiv:2611.28507v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Electrophysiological and haemodynamic recordings resolve brain activity at complementary temporal and spatial scales, yet paired acquisition remains difficult to scale. We propose a generative framework that aligns paired multimodal recordings in a unified representation space and generates modality-specific haemodynamic responses from EEG. In paired cohorts, the framework generated fMRI BOLD and fNIRS haemoglobin responses that reproduced regional dynamics, cortical maps, functional connectivity and task structure. Generated BOLD followed Real BOLD time courses and cortical patterns, while Generated haemoglobin responses tracked task-evoked HbO and HbR dynamics. The framework enabled decoding across visual, motor-imagery and mental-arithmetic tasks, independent-record decoding, external BOLD localization and low-sample augmentation. translated_title: 连接电生理与血流动力学脑活动的统一表征生成式框架
translated_abstract: 电生理记录与血流动力学记录分别在互补的时间和空间尺度上解析大脑活动，然而配对采集仍然难以规模化。我们提出了一种生成式框架，该框架在统一的表征空间中对齐配对的多模态记录，并能够从脑电图（EEG）生成特定模态的血流动力学响应。在配对队列中，该框架生成的fMRI BOLD信号和fNIRS血红蛋白响应再现了区域动态、皮层图谱、功能连接以及任务结构。生成的BOLD信号能够跟随真实BOLD信号的时间进程和皮层空间模式，而生成的血红蛋白响应则能够跟踪任务诱发的氧合血红蛋白（HbO）和脱氧血红蛋白（HbR）动态变化。该框架实现了跨视觉、运动想象和心算任务的解码、独立记录的解码、外部BOLD信号定位以及小样本数据增强。配对特征空间校准还支持了双向检索。
tldr: 该论文提出一种生成式框架，将EEG与血流动力学脑活动对齐至统一表征空间，并能从EEG生成逼真的fMRI BOLD与fNIRS血流响应，实现跨模态任务解码、双向检索与小样本增强。
en_tdlr: A generative framework that aligns EEG and haemodynamic brain activity in a unified representation space and generates realistic fMRI BOLD and fNIRS haemodynamic responses from EEG, enabling cross-modal decoding, bidirectional retrieval, and low-sample augmentation.
